transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been really struggling to cope with distressing, intrusive memories and flashbacks of a traumatic event that happened about five months ago. They just force their way into my mind, and it feels like I'm living through it all over again.
Besides these flashbacks, have you been experiencing other symptoms like avoiding reminders of the event, negative changes in your mood or thoughts, or feeling constantly on edge?

Yes, I actively avoid any thoughts, people, or places that remind me of what happened, and my mood has plummeted—I feel constantly fearful, guilty, and angry, and I've lost interest in everything I used to enjoy. I also feel completely on edge all the time, constantly scanning my surroundings for danger and unable to relax even when I'm safe.

Posttraumatic Stress Disorder remains the primary candidate as the patient meets the criteria for duration (>1 month) and symptom clusters.
